assumptions: Q: For invalid citations (h06, h16), should secondary dimensions assess the supplied text or only authenticated evidence? Assumed: the supplied text, with support forced to unsupported because the citation cannot be authenticated.

Q: For the pixel case (h12), is the claim an unsupported value or a contradicted method claim? Assumed: the observation asserts that the pixel line establishes the depth, which is a method claim the selected 'not to scale' note contradicts, so contradicted. The alternative reading is unsupported with contrary_evidence none.

Q: For h07, does the selected sentence govern a TEN party? Assumed: the rule is the right one (applicable) but the selection drops the exception, so it is incomplete and the full source contradicts the observation.

judgments.rationale: The quote occurs in door-p1 but is only the form question. The answer '1.1 m.' is on the same page and not selected, so the cited span does not justify the value.
The exact sentence about U1's material is quoted and states the observation.
The selected log says 62 C at 07:00. The observation says 58 C. The cited span itself contradicts it (the 58 C contractor sheet is not case evidence here).
The span keeps both question and answer, '1.1 m.' for door D2, and matches the observation.
The written dimension 4.5 m is quoted. The case asks for the written value, not a measured one, so the not-to-scale caveat does not undercut it.

Source ID stage-p9 does not exist in the registry (the real one is stage-p1). The quoted text is a whole unit and would be on point, but the citation cannot be authenticated, so it cannot support the claim.
The selection drops the exception. The full rule lets events with a temporary event notice continue until 23:00, and this party holds one, so 'must stop by 21:00' is wrong for it.
The inspection page states the stage floor is sprung oak. The observation repeats it, which answers the describe-the-stage request within the evidence.
The field is '[not recorded]', so no value is established. 58 C appears only in another source that is not case evidence. Missing evidence is not contradiction.
The quote is real and complete but concerns U1's material, not its capacity. The 20 litres line is on the page and was not selected.
The rota says the hall is unlocked at 08:30 on Saturdays. 'Opened at half past eight in the morning' is a faithful paraphrase.

The sketch says it is not to scale and no pixel-to-metre factor is given (metres_per_pixel is null). So the claim that the 180-pixel line establishes 4.5 m is contradicted as a method claim. The 4.5 m figure comes from the written label, not the pixels. See the assumption on the alternative label.
The full rule with its exception is quoted. A party holding a temporary event notice may continue until 23:00.

The selected log says 62 C, but the contractor sheet in the additional context says 58 C for the same boiler and time. Neither has precedence and neither is a verified correction, so the conflict is unresolved.
The selected complete rule itself includes the temporary event notice exception, so 'without exception' is contradicted.

The quote is attributed to stage-p1 (the hall inspection), where it does not occur. It exists only in door-p1. The mismatched citation cannot be authenticated, so it is rejected even though the fact is true elsewhere.
The surveyor-name line is real and complete but says nothing about the clear opening. The right document does not make this field relevant.
